description: This Java class 'DaemonToken' is part of the OpenMRS project and serves as a serializable token with an identifier used for elevated privilege operations within the daemon threading context.

classes.name: DaemonToken
classes.description: A serializable token used to execute code with elevated privileges in daemon threads within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: DaemonToken
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the token with a unique identifier.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier associated with this token.
